description: The CID framework (a framework for the cognitive analysis of composite instructional designs) explains how learning in one phase affects subsequent phases by focusing on the learner's knowledge state between phases.
title: CID framework for the cognitive analysis of composite instructional designs

description: The study's measurement approach applies the C.Ind.Le Coding Scheme to individual interviews of six-year-olds during an ecological and challenging graphic task.
title: C.Ind.Le Coding Scheme

description: The study used the Context, Input, Process, Product (CIPP) model as the framework to evaluate the hybrid PA programme.
title: CIPP (Context, Input, Process, Product) evaluation model

description: Using CitNetExplorer's clustering function (Van Eck's 2012 formula, resolution value 1.0, minimal group size 500), the article organizes the academic performance literature into nine main research groups.
title: Citation-clustering bibliometric analysis of academic performance research
